name: Notion Marketplace

sources.title: Notion Marketplace page — JS-only shell, confirms marketplace exists
Notion docs: List on the Marketplace — listing dashboard, review process, scope requirements
Notion docs: Public connections — 'Any workspace' scope required for Marketplace eligibility

conditions: Listing is free but gated: you must first build a real public Notion connection (OAuth integration) with installation scope 'Any workspace'
The connection must pass a Notion security review before Marketplace listing
Internal connections and 'Selected workspaces only' connections are not eligible — scope is fixed at creation and cannot be changed later
requirements: A functional public integration using the Notion API — this is not a generic product listing; there must be a working OAuth connection
Installation scope set to 'Any workspace' at connection creation
Listing name, description, category, tags, logo, and listing images
Notion team review and approval before the listing appears
preparation: A built, working Notion public connection (OAuth client, redirect URIs, capabilities configured)
A Notion developer workspace to own the connection
Marketplace assets: square logo, listing images/screenshots, short + long descriptions, category, tags
Evidence for the security review (the connection will be exercised)
workflow: Create a public connection in the Notion integrations dashboard with scope 'Any workspace' (this choice is permanent)
Complete any required verification/security review for public connections
Open the Marketplace listing dashboard > Listings > Connections > 'Start a new connection listing'
Fill name, description, category, tags, images, and associate the public connection; save as draft
Submit for review; track status under the 'Submitted' section until approved
watchFor: This is an integration marketplace — a SaaS with no Notion integration cannot be listed
Scope is irreversible: picking 'Selected workspaces only' permanently disqualifies that connection; create a new one
Review is manual by the Notion team; no published SLA on the page fetched
app.notion.com/profile/connections (batch URL) is the connections management area, not a public submit page
countsAsLive: The connection listing is publicly visible on notion.com/marketplace with an install/connect button pointing at the product's OAuth flow
unknowns: Review timeline (Notion FAQ referenced but not fetched)
Whether templates (non-integration listings) have a separate submission flow under the same marketplace
